heading: The Marginarium: the story so far
first_line: Paul directs a small team of AI agents, and the Marginarium tells how they work, one chapter at a time.
content_why: One passage and one picture per chapter reads like pages you turn, and keeps the README short and about the app first.
avoid: Avoid glossy 3D renders and vector-slick badges on the page; the pictures should look drawn, not manufactured.
